# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 2 (Slot 78): Playable Venice & Genoa Maritime Republics (oe_plat_). Generated by gen_playable_latin_rep.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Initialize Slot 78 global state (idempotent).
oe_plat_global_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plat_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_plat_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_plat_on value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_cnt value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Initialize per-republic variables cleanly.
oe_plat_host_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_oligarchy } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_oligarchy value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_stato_mar } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_stato_mar value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_arsenal_tier } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_arsenal_tier value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_lazzaretto_built } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_lazzaretto_built value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ven_mam_pact } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ven_mam_pact value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_asientos_active } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_asientos_active value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_libro_open } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_libro_open value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Shift oligarchy axis (-100..+100: negative = Great Council, positive = Council of Ten / San Giorgio).
oe_plat_shift_oligarchy = {
	oe_plat_host_init = yes
	change_variable = { name = oe_plat_oligarchy add = $delta$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_plat_oligarchy min = -100 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Safe republican tradition / legitimacy reward (works on any polity including Dev tests).
oe_plat_add_civic_tradition = {
	if = {
		limit = { government_type = government_type:republic }
		add_republican_tradition = $val$
	}
	else = {
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) recalculation of Stato da Mar / Gazaria maritime network integrity (0..4) across 8 verified hubs.
oe_plat_recalc_stato_mar = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_hub_cnt value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { owns = location:candia } change_variable = { name = oe_plat_hub_cnt add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns = location:corfu } change_variable = { name = oe_plat_hub_cnt add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns = location:negroponte } change_variable = { name = oe_plat_hub_cnt add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns = location:chios } change_variable = { name = oe_plat_hub_cnt add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns = location:kaffa } change_variable = { name = oe_plat_hub_cnt add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns = location:nicosia_cyp } change_variable = { name = oe_plat_hub_cnt add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns = location:zara } change_variable = { name = oe_plat_hub_cnt add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns = location:dubrovnik } change_variable = { name = oe_plat_hub_cnt add = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_plat_hub_cnt >= 6 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_stato_mar value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_plat_hub_cnt >= 4 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_stato_mar value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_plat_hub_cnt >= 2 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_stato_mar value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_plat_hub_cnt >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_stato_mar value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_plat_stato_mar value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Fire one event $ev$ on this republic and space monthly popups.
oe_plat_fire_ev = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_cnt add = 1 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_plat.$ev$
}

# Country scope. O(1) chronological & dual-city mirror tick for VEN / GEN.
oe_plat_host_monthly_tick = {
	oe_plat_host_init = yes
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { current_month = 1 current_month = 7 } }
		oe_plat_recalc_stato_mar = yes
	}

	# At most 1 oe_plat event per calendar month per republic.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:oe_plat_ev_m ?= oe_ml_month_now } }
		# Act I: 1345-1415
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_1_fired }
				current_year >= 1345
				current_year <= 1370
				country_exists = c:BYZ
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_1_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_3_fired }
				tag = VEN
				current_year >= 1355
				current_year <= 1415
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_3_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_2_fired }
				current_year >= 1378
				current_year <= 1392
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_2_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 2 }
		}
		# Act II: 1405-1515
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_4_fired }
				tag = GEN
				current_year >= 1407
				current_year <= 1445
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_4_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_5_fired }
				tag = VEN
				current_year >= 1408
				current_year <= 1465
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_5_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_6_fired }
				tag = GEN
				current_year >= 1425
				current_year <= 1485
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_6_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_7_fired }
				tag = VEN
				current_year >= 1423
				current_year <= 1480
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_7_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 7 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_8_fired }
				current_year >= 1472
				current_year <= 1515
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_8_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 8 }
		}
		# Act III: 1500-1675 (incl. Cross-W1 Venice-Mamluk Diu & Cross-W4 Genoese Asientos)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_9_fired }
				country_exists = c:MAM
				OR = {
					oe_plat_mam_timber_requested = yes
					AND = { tag = VEN current_year >= 1502 current_year <= 1528 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_9_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 9 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_10_fired }
				tag = GEN
				current_year >= 1557
				current_year <= 1630
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_10_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_11_fired }
				current_year >= 1568
				current_year <= 1610
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_11_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 11 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_12_fired }
				current_year >= 1610
				current_year <= 1675
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_12_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 12 }
		}
		# Dynamic Sovereign Debt Arbitration
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_16_fired }
				current_year >= 1560
				current_year <= 1770
				OR = {
					var:oe_plat_asientos_active ?= 1
					AND = { has_variable = oe_plat_arsenal_tier var:oe_plat_arsenal_tier >= 2 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_16_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 16 }
		}
		# Act IV: 1680-1800
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_13_fired }
				current_year >= 1685
				current_year <= 1745
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_13_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 13 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_14_fired }
				current_year >= 1725
				current_year <= 1775
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_14_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 14 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_ev_15_fired }
				current_year >= 1780
				current_year <= 1805
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ev_15_fired value = 1 }
			oe_plat_fire_ev = { ev = 15 }
		}
	}
}

# Slot 78 monthly entry point (called by mainline scheduler Slot 78 OR oe_plat_fallback_pulse).
# Strictly idempotent per calendar month via oe_plat_ran_m; O(1) <= 2 tags (VEN & GEN).
oe_plat_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_plat_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_plat_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
		oe_plat_global_init = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_plat_on oe_plat_any_alive = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { is_rebel_country = no } }
				c:VEN = { oe_plat_host_monthly_tick = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { is_rebel_country = no } }
				c:GEN = { oe_plat_host_monthly_tick = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Dev Macro 1: Charter Casa di San Giorgio + 1557 Spanish Asientos & Piacenza Silver Clearinghouse.
oe_plat_dev_macro_san_giorgio_asientos = {
	oe_plat_global_init = yes
	oe_plat_host_init = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_arsenal_tier value = 4 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_asientos_active value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_galleass_ready value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_plat_piacenza_fairs_active value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_econ2_silver_tide } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_silver_tide value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_plat_ref_casa_san_giorgio_bank } }
		add_reform = government_reform:oe_plat_ref_casa_san_giorgio_bank
	}
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_plat_san_giorgio_charter_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_plat_century_of_genoese_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
	oe_plat_recalc_stato_mar = yes
}

# Dev Macro 2: Maximize Venetian Arsenale + Lazzaretto + Venice-Mamluk Diu 1509 Timber Collusion.
oe_plat_dev_macro_arsenale_diu_pact = {
	oe_plat_global_init = yes
	oe_plat_host_init = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_arsenal_tier value = 4 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_lazzaretto_built value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ven_mam_pact value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_galleass_ready value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_plat_lazzaretto_charter value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_plat_ven_mam_timber_sent value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ven_timber_pact value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_plat_ref_serenissima_stato_mar } }
		add_reform = government_reform:oe_plat_ref_serenissima_stato_mar
	}
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_plat_arsenale_assembly_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_plat_lazzaretto_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_plat_levant_spice_lifeline_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
	oe_plat_recalc_stato_mar = yes
}

# Dev Macro 3: Snapshot read-only state variables for oe_plat.90 readout without mutating gameplay state.
oe_plat_prepare_readout = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_oligarchy value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_plat_oligarchy } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_oligarchy value = var:oe_plat_oligarchy } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_stato_mar value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_plat_stato_mar } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_stato_mar value = var:oe_plat_stato_mar } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_arsenal value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_plat_arsenal_tier } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_arsenal value = var:oe_plat_arsenal_tier } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_lazzaretto value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_plat_lazzaretto_built } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_lazzaretto value = var:oe_plat_lazzaretto_built } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_mam_pact value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_plat_ven_mam_pact } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_mam_pact value = var:oe_plat_ven_mam_pact } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pmam_ven_timber_pact } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_mam_pact value = global_var:oe_pmam_ven_timber_pact } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_asientos value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_plat_asientos_active } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_asientos value = var:oe_plat_asientos_active } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_silver_tide value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_econ2_silver_tide } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_silver_tide value = global_var:oe_econ2_silver_tide } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_libro value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_plat_libro_open } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_libro value = var:oe_plat_libro_open } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_itp_ven value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_itp_gen value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
		if = {
			limit = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_itp_ven value = c:BYZ.var:oe_itp_t_ven }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_gen } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_itp_gen value = c:BYZ.var:oe_itp_t_gen }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_ev_cnt value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_plat_ev_cnt } set_variable = { name = oe_plat_rd_ev_cnt value = global_var:oe_plat_ev_cnt } }
}

# Dev Helper: Reset Slot 78 per-country test flags on current country.
oe_plat_dev_reset = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_oligarchy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_stato_mar value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_arsenal_tier value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_lazzaretto_built value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_ven_mam_pact value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_asientos_active value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_plat_libro_open value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_plat_maritime_federation_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_plat_maritime_federation_mod }
}
